scope: Targeted primary-source title/abstract classification and submission/version checks, with selected TouchTwin full text; not full-paper review, independent reproduction, a completed source harvest or conference-acceptance verification.

classification_reviews.title: TouchTwin: Scaling Human Touch Data via Real-to-Sim-to-Real
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract and selected full-text review. Measured TouchScale glove signals ground per-subject human-hand replays in MuJoCo. Perturbed demonstrations carry simulated contact and force labels and condition generated video. The contribution is a touch-grounded data-generation pipeline, not demonstrated cross-robot hand retargeting.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: Human tactile measurements ground simulation; reported policy trials are in simulation. Human-hand replays and real-contact prediction are not evidence of robot-hand retargeting or real-robot policy transfer.

classification_reviews.title: IORA: Irregular Object Immobilization under Restricted Actuation
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract review of v2. Support-aware grasp synthesis matches local hand and object surface graphs, refines wrist pose and motor state, and validates physically executable grasps for low-DoF coupled hands. Restricted actuation is a problem constraint, not an actuator-design contribution.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: The November 13 v2 revision is not a new November paper. Grasp synthesis and support contact do not establish demonstration retargeting.

classification_reviews.title: Objectives as Policies: Vision-Language Model Cost Programs for Contact-Rich Manipulation
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract review. A pretrained VLM writes editable stage-wise objective programs for a shared sampling-based MPC. Programs are revised using simulated rollouts in a real-to-sim digital twin before real-world execution. The central contribution connects language reasoning to contact-aware control through objectives.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: This is VLM-generated objective programming with MPC, not an end-to-end VLA action model or a dexterous-hand retargeting method.

classification_reviews.title: Learning Latent Goal Costs for Visual World-Model Planning with an Expanding Curriculum
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract review. A residual adapter on frozen I-JEPA embeddings learns a goal cost from ordered planner trajectories and progressively expanded initial states. DotWall and PointMaze evaluate latent-cost improvements under frozen encoders and world models.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: The residual adapts a representation used for planning cost; it is not an additive robot-action residual. No hand-retargeting or dexterous-manipulation experiment is established by these task results.

classification_reviews.title: Beyond Prediction Gain: LASR as a Metric for Action-Grounded Latents in World Models
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract review. LASR evaluates whether a latent supports action-related targets beyond state and other predictive shortcuts, with held-out episodes, matched predictors, positive and negative controls, and paired uncertainty comparisons. A lightweight residual adapter is a downstream demonstration of the evaluation protocol.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: The main contribution is an offline evaluation protocol. A latent residual adapter is distinct from a dexterous controller residual, and improved point estimates require the reported uncertainty context.

classification_reviews.title: Agentic-Teacher: An Agentic Data Engine for Failure-Driven VLA Post-Training
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract review. Failure rollouts guide coding-agent construction of closed-loop policies that generate successful demonstration continuations. Correlated action noise, idle-frame handling and frozen-model loss filtering curate demonstrations for VLA post-training. The primary contribution is a demonstration-generation and curation engine.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: Reported LIBERO, MetaWorld and RoboCasa improvements are simulation evaluations. Coding-agent assistance creates training data; the post-trained policy executes without that assistance.

classification_reviews.title: ESI: An Embodied Self-Improvement Flywheel for LLM-VLA Agents
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract review. ESI jointly refines LLM prompts, a shared skill interface and VLA parameters through environmental interaction. Semantic subtask supervision, effective corrections and policy continuations train coordination and handoff in a modular LLM-VLA agent.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: The primary path describes hierarchical agent coordination, not a claim that the model uses a mixture-of-experts network. Reported results cover ten selected RoboDojo tasks rather than universal robot capability.

classification_reviews.title: Training Reasoning Models in Simulation to Natively Use Real Robots
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract review. PEAR trains an open-weight reasoning model with robot-use reinforcement learning in simulation, without demonstrations. The policy reasons from observations and produces the next end-effector pose; held-out instructions, another robot and real-world trials study transfer.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: A robot-use reasoning agent need not share a conventional VLA action-head architecture. Simulation training and the reported real-robot trial outcomes are separate evidence; neither establishes dexterous-hand retargeting.

classification_reviews.title: Vision-Language-Action Models: A Life-Cycle Survey of Design, Training and Deployment
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract review. This survey organizes VLA model design, data, post-training and real-time deployment along seven axes, contrasting action-only and world-action designs. Its contribution is synthesis of existing systems, not a newly validated policy.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: A survey catalog and its quoted model comparisons are not independent replication of the surveyed systems.

classification_reviews.title: On the Utility of Pre-Trained Visual Representations for Policy Learning of Contact-Rich Insertion Tasks
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract review. Controlled comparisons of pretrained visual and explicit contact-centric representations vary occlusion and physical tolerance on two closely related insertion tasks, then examine real-world transfer. The contribution is evidence about representation and task-dependent robustness.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: Insertion results do not establish multifinger or human-to-robot retargeting performance. The paper emphasizes task dependence rather than one representation being universally best.

classification_reviews.title: Modeling the Frictional Contact of Continuum Robots with Environments through Linear Complementarity Problem
classification_reviews.evidence_summary: Title/abstract review. A complementarity-constrained friction model predicts environmental static/sliding friction, hysteresis and resulting continuum-robot deformation, with physical validation on a tendon-driven continuum robot. The contribution is a contact-dynamics model.
classification_reviews.evidence_boundary: The experimental embodiment is a continuum robot, not a multifinger hand. The arXiv comment states IJRR acceptance; that author-provided statement does not make this a paper from the catalog's ten conference venues.

version_checks.title: VOKE: Visual Object Kinematics Estimator for Dexterous In-Hand Manipulation
version_checks.reason: The updated source still contributes object pose, velocity and acceleration perception. A downstream manipulation policy is not the primary retargeting contribution.

publication_claim_reviews.author_stated_acceptance: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Robotics Research (IJRR).
publication_claim_reviews.boundary: The linked DOI was observed on arXiv; independent publisher-deposited acceptance or publication-date verification was not performed in this targeted review.

publication_claim_reviews.title: DexRemo: A Force-Sensing Hand Platform and Task Suite for Contact-Rich Removal Manipulation
publication_claim_reviews.author_stated_acceptance: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO), 2026.
publication_claim_reviews.boundary: T-RO is a journal outside the ten-conference census. The arXiv comment is not independent official-publisher verification and does not create a new conference-layer record.

date_policy: The catalog published field retains original arXiv v1 submission. A replacement date, new-listing date, review date or journal-acceptance comment must not overwrite it.
limitations: These are targeted contribution assignments, not semantic certification of all records in the full catalog.

The inspected cs.RO recent and new pages did not establish a new pure dexterous-hand retargeting paper in the November 13-16 window; this is not proof that no such paper exists in all arXiv categories.
November 16 new listings can contain papers first submitted on November 12 or 13. Original submission dates and later revisions remain separate.
Residual representation or planning-cost adaptation is not automatically residual action control or hand retargeting.
Human-hand touch-grounded replays, simulated policy trials, real-contact prediction and real-robot policy transfer are different evidence levels.
A source date is only advanced by a successful source harvest recorded elsewhere; this targeted review does not claim source-harvest completion.
